The blind itself is great overall. I love being able to see 270 degrees. While the view through the blind walls is not amazing, it is enough to catch movement or see anything near by. Don't expect to see a buck through it at last light unless it is on top of you. The windows are quiet but the slides tend to get caught on each other. Not a big deal though. No stool was included in the package like advertised. I would buy it again.
I have received a full refund, Thank you for the great service!
